raw_segments.text: Stubbswhale had been killed some distance from the ship. It was a calm, so, forming a tandem
of three boats, we commenced the slow business of towing the trophy to the pequod. And now,
as we eighteen men with our thirty-six arms and one hundred and eighty thumbs and fingers,
slowly twalled hour after hour upon that inert, sluggish corpse in the sea. And it seemed
hardly to budge at all, except at long intervals. Good evidence was hereby furnished of the
mass we moved. Four upon the great canal of Hanghou, or whatever they call it in China,
four or five labourers on the footpath will draw a bulky, freighted junk at the rate of a mile an
hour. But this grand Argosy we towed heavily forged along, as if laden with pig lead in bulk.
